articles.summary: DineSafe participated and presented at Georgia Environmental Health Association's Annual Education Conference (GEHA) on August 27th - 29th, 2024, in Lake Lanier, GA. We had the opportunity to discuss the innovative use of consumer crowdsourcing for monitoring real-time food safety trends. It was a pleasure to connect with the GEHA team, public health professionals, environmental health specialists, and more at Lake Lanier. articles.title: DineSafe Presents at Georgia Environmental Health Association's Annual Education Conference
